_note: KEY = app localization locale (the SECOND subtitle track = the user's native language). VALUE = the SECOND most-studied foreign language for the country behind that locale, taken from learn-by-country.json (index [1] of its top-5). Rationale: the #1 studied language is English almost everywhere, so the 2nd entry is what gives per-market variety. Non-obvious locale→country choices: ar→Saudi Arabia, es_419→Mexico, en & en_US→United States, en_GB→United Kingdom, sw→Kenya, bn→Bangladesh, fil→Philippines, he→Israel, fa→Iran, am→Ethiopia, and hi/gu/kn/ml/mr/ta/te→India.
